title_en: Funko Goes All-In on Avengers: Doomsday With a Mighty Lineup of Pop! Figures
summary_en: Funko has revealed a mighty lineup of Avengers: Doomsday Pop! figures, including multiple versions of Doctor Doom himself.
body_en:
As we get closer to the release of Avengers: Doomsday, more and more companies are revealing their toys and collectibles centered around the new MCU movie. Today it's Funko's turn. IGN can exclusively reveal some of Funko's Avengers: Doomsday Pop! figures, a lineup that includes several versions of Robert Downey, Jr.'s Doctor Doom.
Head down to the slideshow gallery below for a closer look at this toy lineup:
This wave focuses mainly on the Avengers and Fantastic Four characters like Mister Fantastic, Yelena Belova, and Steve Rogers, though there will be other figures in the line that focus on the X-Men, as well.
As was previously confirmed by the costume reveals at SDCC 2026 , Doom himself will have multiple costumes in the film. This Funko Pop! wave focuses on both the standard Doctor Doom costume (complete with a tiny Franklin Richards figurine) and the "Lord Doom" suit. However, the latter figure differs from Hot Toys' Victor von Doom figure in that the suit looks more like military formalwear, complete with epaulettes on the shoulders and patches referencing what we assume is the Latverian government.
In addition to these two Doom figures, this lineup also features a pair of diecast metal Doom toys, one of which features a variant chrome metal paint job. The chrome variant is a randomly packed 1:6 chase edition.
Each of these Doomsday Funko Pop! figures is priced at $14.99, except for the diecast Doom, which costs $49.99. The figures will be released ahead of the movie in November 2026.
For more, check out the full lineup of Hot Toys' Avengers: Doomsday figures .
